# tinystruct Development Patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor: architecture and implementation patterns for building modules with tinystruct, a lightweight, high-performance Java framework whose core philosophy is that CLI and HTTP are equal citizens. Every method annotated with @Action is a routable endpoint for both the terminal and the web, with no main() method and minimal configuration. Covers creating Application classes by extending AbstractApplication, defining routes and command-line actions with @Action, per-request state via Context, JSON serialization with the native Builder and Builders components to keep a zero-dependency footprint, database persistence with AbstractData POJOs and XML mapping files, POJO generation from tables with the generate command, Server-Sent Events for real-time push, multipart file uploads, outbound HTTP with URLRequest and HTTPHandler, database and system configuration in application.properties, and debugging routing conflicts or CLI argument parsing. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: tinystruct is a niche framework with a small community; the patterns assume Java and the tinystruct runtime. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
